unreleased_commits.message:
chore: remove govulncheck-go workflow superseded by OSV-Scanner

OSV-Scanner (osv-scanner-full.yml / osv-scanner-pr.yml) now provides
dependency vulnerability scanning for this repository, so the Go-only
govulncheck workflow is redundant.

The two govulncheck GOVERSION targets are dropped from .repver as well,
because repver fails when a target file cannot be read, and the file is
removed from the .managedfiles manifest.
